name: g29_trick_scarf
purpose: Farigiraf (Leftovers) tricks a Raichu that holds a Choice Scarf: -activate, then -item for each (Raichu gets the Leftovers, which heal it in the residual; Farigiraf gets the Scarf, which locks it into its next move and speeds it up); a second Trick of the Scarf holder at a Staraptor with a Sharp Beak, and the Scarf and its lock go on to the Staraptor.
